title: Relay for macOS launch
excerpt: In the few days before 2026 I will launch the first version of my indie app with gifting
analysis: The post opens with a product reveal line. That label comes from the post text, not from watching the video. Reported 165 views and 5 likes on the gallery listing, a like rate of 3.03 percent, above the library median of 0.56 percent. At 106 seconds it compares best with the 120 second structure.
